metric.description: Sampled policy return is the default; greedy return can be dominated by fixed rules.

floor.description: Return that scores zero, e.g. -200 for MountainCar-v0.

ceiling.description: Return that scores one; values beyond it are clamped.

tail_fraction.description: Fraction of worst seeds in the robustness term.

tail_weight.description: Weight of the worst-seed mean against the all-seed mean.
